editorial.name: Acuity Scheduling
editorial.descriptionZh: 按行业切分预约流程的排期软件，客户在品牌化页面上自助选时间、填表单、付定金，商家侧管员工排班、课程、发票和 POS。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看它怎么按行业把预约拆成六个解决方案
editorial.noteZh: 首屏浅紫底，导航 How It Works / Solutions / Product / Resources / Pricing 加 Log in 与 Get started，主标题是衬线体 Scheduling software to power exceptional client experiences，按钮下写 No credit card needed。往下压着一块紫色大卡，卡里是 Mr. Minoru 的示例预约页（* Your favorite Japanese language tutor *、Products & Packages），左右两侧各露出奶油色和黄色的邻卡。正文往后是 See it through your client's eyes 与 Acuity is for anyone in the business of time 两段，后者把行业列成 Beauty、Business Services、Wellness、Fitness、Visual and Performing Arts、Education 六格；再往下 Everything you need to run your business 拆成 Book beautifully, 24/7、Reduce no-shows、Automate your day、Boost your earnings 四块，页脚前是 Dan Kellner、Noelle Saladin、Paula Salamanca 三条带行业标签的客户证言。
editorial.pricing: Free trial - 首屏写 No credit card needed，meta description 写 Start a free trial today!；档位在 /pricing

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Acuity 这个排期产品的行业解决方案与功能分区，用户拿走的是落地页结构与文案，没有可下载的组件或素材。
站内路径是 /solutions/<行业>、/features/<功能>、/compare/acuity-vs-* 这类自家产品页，另有 /learn 案例博客，形态是产品官网而非案例集。
